name: Surfing the Parallel Architectures
description: This board-level presentation surveys the 1994 commercial parallel-computing market across uniprocessors, SMP systems, clusters, and massively parallel machines, then compares the leading hardware and database suppliers against Tandem's position. Kastner argues that software-enabled clustering and parallel databases will matter more than pure MPP experimentation, and he frames data warehousing plus distributed object computing as Tandem's best near-term strategic opening. The deck combines architecture taxonomy, vendor-by-vendor competitive critique, and explicit forward-looking judgments about how the market would evolve.
